title: Telehealth Visit Intake Form
subtitle: Capture patient location, technology check, identity verification, and privacy setting; confirm clinician connection and backup route.
description: Telehealth Visit records patient location, technology check, identity verification, privacy setting, clinician connection, and backup route. Telehealth Visit evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this telehealth visit structured intake when staff must document patient location and technology check. Reconcile identity verification, privacy setting, clinician connection, and backup route before the telehealth visit handoff. Use the appointment record, identity verification, physical-location confirmation, technology test, privacy check, clinician connection log, emergency backup, and after-visit handoff. This encounter centers remote connection readiness, video or audio platform, patient physical location, private setting, callback reliability, clinician link, local emergency route, and reconnection fallback. Ask the assigned telehealth visit reviewer to confirm patient location against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Telehealth Visit contact and reference
sections.guidance: Verify patient identity and physical location, callback number, privacy setting, technology readiness, clinician connection, emergency jurisdiction, and backup route. Keep any urgent telehealth visit issue with its escalation contact and time.

sections.title: Telehealth Visit reported needs review
sections.guidance: Preserve the person's wording and route questions without interpretation.

blocks.label: Telehealth Visit stated need or goal

fields.label: Person's words, desired outcome, and priority

blocks.label: Telehealth Visit intake readiness
items: Patient location is identified for this record
Technology check matches the current request or source
Identity verification is ready for point-of-use staff
Privacy setting limits or questions are resolved
Clinician connection is communicated to the responsible person

sections.title: Telehealth Visit receiving route
sections.guidance: Assign open questions and confirm where the intake goes next.

blocks.label: Telehealth Visit intake receipt
blocks.guidance: Receipt confirms routing, not professional review.
